format: Makefile (shell scripting and GNU Make syntax)
description: This file is a Makefile fragment for building the Linux kernel within the OpenWrt build system. It includes definitions for downloading, configuring, compiling, and cleaning kernel components, as well as handling dependencies and debug information.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the kernel build environment using default settings.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure
methods.description: Configures the kernel build environment using default settings.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules using default settings.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage
methods.description: Compiles the kernel image and initramfs.

methods.name: Download/kernel
methods.description: Defines download parameters for the Linux kernel source.

methods.name: Download/git-kernel
methods.description: Defines download parameters for the kernel source from a git repository.

methods.name: Kernel/CollectDebug
methods.description: Collects debug symbols and creates a debug tarball of the kernel.
